Hi Nikhil / Monica,

Thanks again for the intro during LaunchHub last week — Brightline Labs is excited about Redwood and we think your runtime could meaningfully reduce inference cost for our summarization pipeline. We have a quick ask as we prepare for a 12-week pilot with LaunchHub starting Nov 1.

Request overview:
- 100k token credits to cover the pilot (we anticipate ~30k tokens/week)
- 50% introductory unit pricing for the first 3 months (to help us get meaningful usage)

Best,
Priya Rao

Thanks for the details, everyone. Quick pricing proposal and guardrails from my side:

Proposal (pilot package):
- One-time credit grant: 80,000 token credits (to be applied to the account upfront)
- Introductory unit price: 40% off list for first 3 months (applies to overages after credits are consumed)
- Commitment: pilot runs for 12 weeks; Brightline publishes a short case study and allows logo use if KPIs are met
- Revenue ops: require an MRR commit threshold to activate the 40% discount window for future conversions (standard practice for accelerator deals)

Rationale / notes:
- 100k credits + 50% off is above our standard accelerator playbook for a single early-stage company. I can approve the 80k + 40% in principle, but anything beyond that needs a pricing exception from RevOps (Lauren can trigger).
- We should bake in an automatic step-down after month 3 back to standard list pricing unless converted to a committed plan.

If that sounds reasonable, Lauren can open the promo exception and I’ll draft a short customer-facing onboarding plan (token burn guidance, recommended batching settings, and suggested KPIs).

-Ben
Senior Growth Manager, Redwood Inference

Approved package:
- One-time credit grant: 90,000 token credits (applied at account creation)
- Introductory unit price: 40% off list for the first 3 months on any overage after credits
- Pilot term: 12 weeks starting Nov 1; automatic reversion to standard pricing unless converted to a committed plan
- Deliverables: Brightline provides a short case study and logo placement; Redwood will provide a 1-page onboarding playbook and a 60-min setup session

Attachments: Onramp-plan.xlsx (onboarding checklist + token burn guidance)
Action items:
- Priya: confirm concurrency/peak qps and sign the term sheet in DocuSign by Oct 16
- Lauren: open the promo exception ticket and provision the 90k credits upon DocuSign completion
- Ben: send the customer-facing onboarding playbook and recommended batching settings

Best,
Monica Patel
